tasks.label: Lint: ruff
tasks.command: ruff check usr/local/bin/ || python3 -m ruff check usr/local/bin/

tasks.label: Lint: shellcheck + bash -n
tasks.command: shellcheck -S warning install.sh usr/local/sbin/*.sh; for f in install.sh usr/local/sbin/*.sh; do bash -n "$f"; done

tasks.label: Build: libmodbus + apc_modbus from vendor/ (local)
tasks.command:
set -e
W=/tmp/nutb; rm -rf "$W"; mkdir -p "$W"
tar -xzf vendor/libmodbus-*.tar.gz -C "$W"
(cd "$W"/libmodbus-* && ./configure --prefix=/usr/local && make -j"$(nproc)")
tar -xzf vendor/nut-2.8.5-src.tar.gz -C "$W"
# same APC_VF_UNAVAILABLE setvar guard as install.sh
if grep -q '!(apc_value->value_flags & APC_VF_UNAVAILABLE)' "$W"/nut-2.8.5/drivers/apc_modbus.c; then
  sed -i 's/!(apc_value->value_flags \& APC_VF_UNAVAILABLE)/(apc_value->value_flags \& APC_VF_UNAVAILABLE)/' "$W"/nut-2.8.5/drivers/apc_modbus.c
fi
(cd "$W"/nut-2.8.5 && ./configure --with-drivers=apc_modbus --with-modbus+usb=yes --with-doc=no --without-asciidoc --without-pkg-config && make -j"$(nproc)")
file "$W"/nut-2.8.5/drivers/apc_modbus

tasks.label: Package: release tarball (like release.yml)
tasks.command:
set -e
V=${input:pkgVersion}
rm -rf pkg/apcupspi-* apcupspi-*.tar.gz*
mkdir -p "pkg/apcupspi-$V"
git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "pkg/apcupspi-$V"
tar --sort=name --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner -czf "apcupspi-$V.tar.gz" -C pkg "apcupspi-$V"
sha256sum "apcupspi-$V.tar.gz" | tee "apcupspi-$V.tar.gz.sha256"

tasks.label: Pi: deploy web UI + agent + updater
tasks.command:
set -e
H="${input:piUser}@${input:piHost}"
sshpass -p '${input:piPass}' scp -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null \
  usr/local/bin/apc-nmc-web.py usr/local/bin/apc-nmc-agent.py \
  usr/local/bin/apc-nmc-web/nmc.css usr/local/sbin/apc-nmc-update.sh \
  etc/systemd/system/apc-nmc-update-rollback.service "$H":/tmp/
sshpass -p '${input:piPass}' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null "$H" 'set -e
install -m 0755 /tmp/apc-nmc-web.py /usr/local/bin/
install -m 0755 /tmp/apc-nmc-agent.py /usr/local/bin/
install -m 0644 /tmp/nmc.css /usr/local/bin/apc-nmc-web/
install -m 0755 /tmp/apc-nmc-update.sh /usr/local/sbin/
install -m 0644 /tmp/apc-nmc-update-rollback.service /etc/systemd/system/
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart apc-nmc-web snmpd
systemctl is-active apc-nmc-web snmpd'

tasks.label: Pi: service status
tasks.command: sshpass -p '${input:piPass}' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null "${input:piUser}@${input:piHost}" 'systemctl is-active apc-nmc-web nut-server upsmon snmpd nut-driver@myups apc-nmc-update-check.timer; cat /etc/apc-nmc/version'

tasks.label: Release: bump VERSION + commit
tasks.command: echo "${input:newVersion}" > VERSION && git add VERSION && git commit -m "Bump version to ${input:newVersion}" && git show --stat HEAD

tasks.label: Publish: tag + push (triggers release.yml)
tasks.command: git push origin main && git tag "${input:tagVersion}" && git push origin "${input:tagVersion}" && echo "Release workflow should now publish tag ${input:tagVersion}"

inputs.description: New version to write into VERSION (e.g. 1.1.1)
Tag to create + push (e.g. 1.1.1 or v1.1.1)
Version label for the local release tarball
